item.title: Pentagon prepares for weeks of ground operations in Iran
item.summary: If President Trump approves the plans, such an effort would mark a new phase of the war that could be significantly more dangerous to U.S. troops than the first four weeks.

item.title: Trump officials cite white supremacists in bid to end birthright citizenship
item.summary: An argument heading to the Supreme Court is built in part on a post-Civil War campaign that scholars say was steeped in anti-Black and anti-Chinese racism.

item.title: Trump shows off new ballroom designs as he defends $400 million project
item.summary: The planned White House addition, a top priority of the president, is facing a key vote this week. A federal judge may also rule to halt the project.

item.title: He took Pelosi’s lectern on Jan. 6. Now he’s running for office.
item.summary: Adam Johnson has rarely voted and embraces his role as clown prince of Jan. 6. Floridians will decide whether a man who tried to upend democracy can help lead one.

item.title: ICE agents may remain at airports even after TSA agents get paid
item.summary: As the partial shutdown drags on, border czar Tom Homan says the decision will depend in part on whether TSA agents “come back to work.”

item.title: Kash Patel’s push against Democratic lawmaker raises concerns within FBI
item.summary: FBI Director Kash Patel is pushing to post documents related to a Democratic lawmaker who has not been accused of wrongdoing, raising alarms within the Bureau.
